pinTitle: Why Postpartum Hair Loss Peaks at 3–5 Months (and What Actually Helps)
pinDescription: Losing hair by the handful after having a baby? It's telogen effluvium, a predictable shift in your hair cycle—not a deficiency. Learn why shedding peaks a few months postpartum and what the evidence says about managing it.
